sign_convention: dF=F_D-F_H; Delta_anh=dF_fit-dF_harmonic at same P; residual=Delta_anh(16)-Delta_anh(128)
limitations: Fixed-atom 1D estimate covering O-H stretch and the 1D O...O transfer coordinate only, not stretch-bend coupling or other collective anharmonicity. Reduced and bare masses are alternative models of the same fixed-atom PES, not additional modes. Fit and grid diagnostics qualify this estimate; it is not a rigorous PIMD error bound. A scan whose endpoint slope points inward is cut at its outermost fitted maximum (flag truncated_at_endpoint); any well beyond the scanned range is not modelled.
